description: This file defines an interface for a wrapper around GLib functions, including methods for object property management, signal handling, memory allocation, and type information. It also includes a factory class for obtaining a singleton instance of the wrapper. The file is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace and is intended for use in a media server context, specifically related to GStreamer integration.
